question: The Salt march was launched by Mahatma Gandhi in the year:
solution:
The correct answer is __**1930**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Salt March was a significant event in the Indian independence movement led by Mahatma Gandhi.
 
• It commenced on **March 12, 1930**, and was a direct action campaign of tax resistance and nonviolent protest against the British salt monopoly.
 
• The march lasted for 24 days, covering a distance of 240 miles from Sabarmati Ashram to the coastal village of Dandi.
 
• Upon reaching Dandi on April 6, 1930, Gandhi defied the salt laws by making salt from seawater, sparking widespread acts of civil disobedience against British rule.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Salt March is also known as the Dandi March or the Salt Satyagraha.
 
• This event was a pivotal turning point in the Indian independence struggle and helped galvanize the Indian population against British colonial rule.
 
• Gandhi's leadership and the nonviolent approach inspired many future movements for civil rights and freedom across the world.
 
• The march demonstrated the power of mass mobilization and nonviolent resistance in challenging oppressive systems.
